$comment: Profile-level status explanation, read by one test per language. Legacy exec-json carries two overlapping fields — status_message, documented as "the reason for the status, example: why it was skipped or failed to load", and skip_message, "the reason for skipping if it was skipped" — while the closed Evaluated_Baseline declares only statusMessage. TypeScript used to emit skip_message under a skipMessage key the schema forbids, which passed only because the validator did not yet enforce unevaluatedProperties; Go read status_message and dropped skip_message outright. Both now fold into the one declared slot. `profile` is spliced into a legacy profile verbatim, so an absent key is an absent field and an explicit null is the null the legacy schema permits on both fields. `want: null` means statusMessage is omitted.

cases.name: status_message wins when it carries text
skip_message fills the slot when status_message is absent
skip_message fills the slot when status_message is empty
skip_message fills the slot when status_message is null
an empty status_message is kept when nothing else explains the status
a null skip_message is absence, not data

dependencyCases.$comment: Dependency conversion, read by one test per language. `dependency` is spliced into a legacy profile's depends array verbatim and `want` is the whole converted dependency, so a field appearing in neither is asserted absent. The legacy exec-json Dependency declares nine fields and sets additionalProperties: true; HDF's Dependency is a 1:1 camelCase mirror of those nine and is closed. TypeScript therefore produced invalid output three ways — it emitted tag, commit and version (keys the format does not define and no published sample carries), emitted skip_message under a skipMessage key, and copied every unrecognized key straight into the closed shape. Both languages also dropped status_message, which HDF does declare: it sat in TypeScript's known-field set unmapped, and Go's legacy type had no field for it at all.

cases.name: every declared field is carried under its declared name
skip_message fills the slot when status_message is absent
status_message wins when both carry text
skip_message fills the slot when status_message is empty
an empty status_message is kept when nothing else explains the status
a null skip_message is absence, not data
tag, commit and version are dropped because the format does not define them
an unrecognized key is dropped, not copied into the closed shape
a null declared field is absence, not data
